typography.$description: Everything to do with setting text. Nested deliberately, so the sidebar has one group with real depth in it.

font.$description: Two families: one for reading, one for code.

system.$description: The single-string form the spec also allows, which holds one name. Which form was authored has to survive an edit, so both are here.

text.$description: Type sizes, bound to the sizing scale so they move with it rather than drifting from it.

leading.$description: Line height. Tighter as type gets larger.

weight.$description: Weights in both forms the spec allows — a number and a keyword — because which one was authored has to survive an edit.

style.$description: The composite. Every sub-field is itself a typed value, and most of them are optional — so this is the shape a single text box cannot hold.

body.$description: All five sub-fields, each one a reference.

heading.$description: The minimum the spec requires: family and size, nothing else. Adding a weight here is a create, not an edit.

code.$description: Literal sub-values rather than references, so both authoring styles are present.
